description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {3}.
Sculpting Steel enters as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sculpting Steel triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.
